body:
Welcome to the world of SuperMouth, where cutting-edge innovation meets comprehensive oral care. At SuperMouth, we don’t just see the mouth as a set of teeth; we view it as a complex ecosystem that plays a vital role in your overall health. Our approach goes beyond the typical “fluoride vs. non-fluoride” debate. We’re dedicated to providing a full spectrum of oral care that supports not only enamel but also gums, the oral microbiome, and overall well-being. With over 200 products, nearly 300 patents, and a passion for educating both dental professionals and the public, we’re redefining what it means to take care of your mouth.

Hydroxamin®: Our Breakthrough in Enamel Support

At the core of SuperMouth’s product line is Hydroxamin—our patented Liquid Enamel Technology™. This powerful blend combines nano-hydroxyapatite, Vitamin D3, and Vitamin K2 to help restore and strengthen teeth. Nano-hydroxyapatite is a biomimetic form of calcium phosphate, the same mineral that makes up 97% of tooth enamel. This advanced formulation helps restore and strengthen enamel by filling in microscopic cracks, supporting enamel health and reducing tooth sensitivity. The addition of Vitamins D3 and K2 enhances calcium absorption, making Hydroxamin an essential part of a comprehensive approach to enamel care. While fluoride remains the only FDA-approved ingredient for cavity prevention, Hydroxamin offers a complementary benefit by reinforcing the enamel’s natural structure.

SuperBristles®: Redefining Toothbrush Technology

Toothbrushes are often overlooked in the conversation about oral health, but at SuperMouth, we believe they’re just as important as the toothpaste you use. Our revolutionary SuperBristles technology represents a significant leap forward in toothbrush design. After scanning thousands of teeth, we developed bristles that conform to the natural curves of your teeth, providing a far superior cleaning experience.

  • SuperBristles Pro: Found in our manual SuperBrush® line, these bristles clean teeth up to 30 times more effectively than standard manual brushes.
  • Ultim8™ SmartBrush™ System: Our most advanced toothbrush yet, featuring SuperBristles Pro that clean up to an incredible 40 times more effectively.
  • SuperBristles Ortho: Specifically designed for those with braces or other orthodontic devices, these bristles clean up to an astonishing 60 times better around brackets and wires. 

Customization: Tailoring Care for Every Age and Stage

One size does not fit all when it comes to oral care. That’s why SuperMouth offers customization based on age, stage, risk factors, and personal preferences. Whether you’re caring for a teething baby, a teenager with braces, or an adult with sensitive gums, we have the perfect system for you. From our custom-tailored systems based on age or stage to our advanced toothpastes and mouthwashes, SuperMouth provides a comprehensive solution for every family member.

Innovating Oral Health with Fun and Education

At SuperMouth, we’re not just about products; we’re about creating an experience. We’ve developed a world of superheroes and supervillains—the SuperMouth Squad—through movies, music, comics, and augmented reality to make oral care fun for kids and build positive associations from the beginning. Our stunning designs and colors also make oral care a joy for adults, ensuring that taking care of your mouth is something to look forward to, not just a chore.

The SuperMouth Difference

SuperMouth is more than just an oral care brand; it’s a revolution in how we think about and take care of our mouths. With cutting-edge science, innovative products, and a comprehensive approach that considers the entire mouth and its impact on overall health, SuperMouth is changing the landscape of oral care. Join us in this revolution and experience the future of oral health care today.
